name: 便携酒精消毒湿巾干净随行款
description: 含酒精湿巾绵柔擦拭、袋装锁鲜、随身便携，手部桌面多场景清洁

styleLock.backgroundSystem: pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, sky-blue #AEE3F2 and pale grey #F2F4F6 for info and scene shots, lake-teal #2FB0BC reserved for the closing shot
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone counter #EDE7DF and neutral matte board #F2F4F6
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single teal accent
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the pack across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean hygiene visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, sky-blue #AEE3F2, lake-teal accent #2FB0BC and charcoal text #2D2D2D; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and centered placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 首屏天蓝背景堆头图（含 75% 与 99.9% 杀灭类文案）；P2 白底四宫格功能卡（75%、99% 圆环数字卡）；P3 两张功能卡（亲肤无纺布、滋润不干燥）加白底文字过渡屏；P4 四个灰白柱形占位与四类微生物分类条目；P5 天蓝大字屏加绿叶水珠氛围图；P6 灰底科学配比图（四个彩色圆圈均标注同一菌名，明显为设计错误，未采信）；P7 湖青说明条加棉柔材质文案屏；P8 灰蓝底贴合手掌尺寸文案屏（无实测数值）；P9 六宫格适用场景图（键盘、玩具、手机、电梯楼道、冰箱等）；P10 湖青产品参数表（名称酒精消毒湿巾，尺寸与片数与 P1 的片数角标互相矛盾，两种数值均未采信）。品类判定依据：P10 参数区品名为酒精消毒湿巾，属清洁消毒用品而非洗护发，taxonomy 中护肤个护下设有清洁消毒类目，故 L1/L2 逐字取 护肤个护/清洁消毒，与源夹名洗护一致但 L2 未取洗护发。已剥离：原品牌与英文标语字样、包装面贴美术与印字、会员招募贴片与二维码、全部杀灭率与浓度百分比、GMP 车间等资质表述、片数与尺寸数值、原文案原句；功效断言一律以 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 占位，信任屏留空印章框占位；全篇未出现可辨识人像，未编造任何成分、检测或规格事实。
